svg.title: Build pipeline: three templates and one manifest pull request in terraform
svg.desc: build.yml runs three packer build jobs on the self-hosted runner. The base job comes first, in five steps: the proxmox-iso.base source boots the Debian 13 netinst ISO in VM 900 on Proxmox; http/preseed.cfg.tmpl, served over HTTP on port 8000, installs Debian unattended; scripts/base.sh upgrades the system, installs cloud-init and moves to netplan; the cloud-init directory is copied to /etc/cloud; scripts/seal.sh resets the identity and removes the builder user. The result is template 900 (base). The k3s and storage jobs then run in parallel, each cloning template 900 with proxmox-clone. The k3s job clones it into VM 901 and runs scripts/k3s.sh: a kernel-series gate, the DKMS driver install, a DKMS status gate, the GRUB command line and the ModemManager purge, then scripts/seal.sh, giving template 901 (k3s). The storage job clones it into VM 902 and runs scripts/storage.sh: targetcli-fb, LVM with stock activation off, nftables and the node exporter, then scripts/seal.sh, giving template 902 (storage). Each manifest post-processor writes packer-manifest.json. After k3s, create-release publishes a GitHub release. After k3s and storage, push-manifest opens one pull request packer-build-run in terraform with every built template's entry, k3s and storage, merged by name by scripts/merge-manifest.sh; a failed build keeps its old entry. A person merges the pull request.
svg.text: Bake three templates, ship one manifest
first job of build.yml, runs packer build -force -only='proxmox-iso.base' in hashicorp/packer:light

g.text: Boot the installer in VM 900 on Proxmox
Upgrade, add cloud-init, switch to netplan
Debian 13 netinst ISO, checksum from Debian's SHA256SUMS; q35, virtio disk and NIC
answers served over HTTP on port 8000; root login off, a temporary builder user for SSH
netplan with systemd-networkd replaces ifupdown; no GPU stack and no compiler
copied to /etc/cloud: NoCloud and ConfigDrive datasources, root login disabled
resets the machine ID and cloud-init state, deletes the builder user and its sudoers file

svg.text: both clone jobs start from it

g.text: A kernel outside the pinned series, or a driver that DKMS
did not install for the boot kernel, fails the build.
Stock LVM activation is off in the system and every initramfs;
a compiler in the image fails the build.

svg.text: the k3s and storage entries, merged by name; k3s at builds[0]
every build that succeeded replaces its entry by name;
a failed build keeps its old entry, others are kept
Nothing downstream runs until the pull request is merged. Only the three build jobs use the self-hosted runner.
